name: Volume Encoding Gaussians
aliases: Transfer Function-Agnostic 3D Gaussians for Volume Rendering
definition: Adapts 3D Gaussian Splatting for volume data visualization by removing color and opacity attributes for each Gaussian, training only scalar values and enabling interactive transfer function application post-training.
summary: Volume Encoding Gaussians adapts 3D Gaussian Splatting by training only scalar density values, enabling interactive transfer function application post-training without storing explicit color or opacity attributes.
